reviews.title: Absolutely golden
reviews.comment:
For less than what I could spend in 2 packages of cookies and 1 mayonnaise I've got one beast of a CPU, came in excellent condition, swear it feels like it's brand new and the performance is off the charts.  28-threads of pure brute power, it runs my VMs like it's a walk in the park.
I've bought this to upgrade my Windows Server that I use as internet gateway, now I could pretty much use this for anything.  I'm going to setup a Plex Server with this no doubt!.
It is amazing that people still do not realize they could have a beast of a machine for a quarter of the costs.  A brand new modern CPU cost no less than $250.  Do the math.
THANK YOU GOD for all the old servers being sold as scrap, I am planning on buying more :)
